newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS adjust Swiss Re estimates up.
newsitem.headline: UBS adjust Swiss Re estimates up.

text.p: Analysts at Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) have adjusted upwards their 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Swiss Reinsurance Co. and retained a "buy" rating.

Following Swiss Re's presentation of detailed 1996 results on Tuesday, analysts Thomas Kalbermatten and A.-V. Schaffner estimated in a research note that Swiss Re's earnings per share (EPS) should rise to 117 francs in 1997 from 100 in 1996 and to 136 in 1998.
Despite the strong rise in Swiss Re shares, UBS said Swiss Re stock still shows a significant discount of around 15 percent to the total market based on estimated 1997/98 price/earnings.
Swiss Re's shares are trading at a prospective 1997 price/earnings (P/E) ratio of 15.6 and 13.4 for 1998 P/E.
UBS said Swiss Re shares are therefore still favourably valued and it confirmed its buy recommendation with a price target of 2,000 francs by end-1997.
Swiss Re shares were up 72 francs on Wednesday to 1,906 francs at 1230 GMT.
